                                                                                    2 March 2026

        Spring plant sale


        Dear Sir or Madam,

        Thank you for your enquiry about the spring plant sale. We are pleased to confirm
        that the sale takes place on Saturday, 14 March, starting at ten o’clock in the greenhouse
        behind the main hall.
        Please note the following:

            • Bring your own bags and boxes.
            • Seedlings are sold in trays of twelve.
            • Payment is accepted in cash only.

        We look forward to seeing you there.

               Kind regards


        Example Garden Society
